# Draft:Rajeswari S raina

Rajeswari Sarala Raina is an Indian social scientist. Currenty she is a professor at the [https://snu.edu.in/schools/school-of-humanities-and-social-sciences/ School of Humanities and Social Sciences], Shiv Nadar University, Delhi-NCR. Her research work falls under the intersection of Economics, Development Studies and Science and Technology Studies.
Books
* Rajeswari S. Raina and Keshab Das (eds.). 2020. [https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-81-322-3929-1 Inclusive Innovation: Evidence and Options in Rural India] (India Studies in Business and Economics). Springer.
* [https://www.eur.nl/people/julien-francois-gerber Julien-François Gerber] and Rajeswari S. Raina. 2018. [https://www.orientblackswan.com/details?id=9789352873937#:~:text='Post%2Dgrowth'%20calls%20for,growth%2Ddriven%20model%20of%20development. Post-Growth Thinking in India]. Hyderabad: Orient Blackswan.
* Rajeswari S. Raina (ed.). 2015. [https://www.orientblackswan.com/books?id=0&sid=0&pid=0 Science, Technology and Development in India]. Hyderabad: Orient Blackswan.
